about.text: British cream with at least 48 % fat, the richest after clotted cream: thick enough to spoon, it whips easily and can go into hot sauces without splitting.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

facts.v: Extra-thick double cream is also 48 %, heat-treated then quickly cooled. In Australia and New Zealand double cream is listed at 48–60 %
